subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When direct issue entry encounters ambiguous scope, changed source, blocked dependencies, unsupported routing evidence, exhausted implementation/review bounds, or a publication/verification failure, the executor shall preserve existing work and shared evidence, return a typed non-success result, and stop within the existing budgets. It shall not author a planning pipeline, recursively split work, watch later comments, or merge as an implicit recovery action.
rationale: bounded first delivery can grow later without hiding additional agents or authority
fit_criterion: failure fixtures terminate with a reason and resumable references; no unselected work, watcher, decomposition, planning artifacts, or merge action is created; unsupported activated routing evidence refuses before claim
